name: US Secondary Units
description: Every secondary unit designator in USPS Publication 28 Appendix C2, abbreviated, in full and after a comma, plus the # form and common variants. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
